{
  "type": "CodeMissionDraft",
  "mission": "Configure vault",
  "repo": "https://github.com/example/vault",
  "branch": "main",
  "requirements": ["Vault integration"],
  "constraints": ["no hardcoded secrets"],
  "non_goals": [],
  "priority": "P0",
  "complexity": "high",
  "thomas_notes": "Critical security.",
  "steps": [
    {
      "step": "1. Integrate Vault client into the application",
      "description": "Add Vault client library to the project dependencies and configure it to communicate with the Vault server. Use environment variables or a secure config file to store Vault address, token, and authentication method.",
      "deliverables": ["Updated dependencies file (e.g., package.json, build.gradle)", "Vault client configuration code"]
    },
    {
      "step": "2. Migrate hardcoded secrets to Vault",
      "description": "Replace all hardcoded secrets in the codebase with references to Vault secret paths. Use Vault's KV secrets engine to store secrets securely. Ensure secrets are not committed to version control.",
      "deliverables": ["Modified code files with Vault secret references", "Vault secret paths documentation"]
    },
    {
      "step": "3. Implement dynamic secret retrieval",
      "description": "Modify application logic to fetch secrets from Vault at runtime using the client library. Handle token renewal and error recovery for Vault connectivity.",
      "deliverables": ["Secret retrieval implementation code", "Error handling logic"]
    },
    {
      "step": "4. Configure Vault policies",
      "description": "Create Vault policies restricting application access to only required secret paths. Assign policies to the application's Vault token/role.",
      "deliverables": ["Vault policy files", "Policy binding documentation"]
    },
    {
      "step": "5. Secure environment configuration",
      "description": "Ensure Vault credentials (tokens, CA certificates) are stored securely using environment variables or a secrets management tool. Implement proper rotation mechanisms.",
      "deliverables": ["Environment variable setup guide", "Secret rotation strategy"]
    },
    {
      "step": "6. Implement secret validation",
      "description": "Add startup checks to verify successful secret retrieval from Vault before proceeding with application initialization.",
      "deliverables": ["Secret validation code", "Startup healthcheck implementation"]
    }
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    "Vault server access credentials",
    "Vault CLI/SDK for language framework",
    "Secrets management documentation"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "Insufficient Vault permissions causing runtime failures",
    "Exposed Vault credentials in logs/environment",
    "Insecure secret storage during migration"
  ],
  "testing": [
    "Unit tests for secret retrieval logic",
    "Integration tests with mock Vault server",
    "End-to-end secret rotation test",
    "Security audit of secret handling paths"
  ],
  "documentation": [
    "Vault integration setup guide",
    "Secret migration checklist",
    "Security hardening best practices"
  ]
}
```
